text:
Noah (CSM): Mina - quick health check. Were seeing an increasing p95 on your payments-chat route during EU mornings (~06:00-08:30 CET). Renewal conversation in 3 weeks; want to propose a low-risk perf plan. Any hard constraints on model artifacts or routing changes?

Mina (SablePoint): Were on Private (eu-central). Security requires artifact checksums and a short review, but we can canary changes. Primary workload: short confirmations (~65%) and medium explanations (~25%). Throughput is reserved; dont want to change slot counts pre-renewal.

Rafael (Solutions Eng): Low friction options: 1) route short confirmations to a quantized small model (redwood/phoenix-6b-q4) 2) enable prefix KV for repeated invoice templates 3) reduce max_batch_latency for medium gens to improve tail. Example routing snippet we can stage:```yaml
routes:
  - match: {intent: "confirm", tokens: "<120"}
    target: redwood/phoenix-6b-q4
  - match: {intent: "explain", tokens: "120-600"}
    target: redwood/aurora-20b
inference:
  batching:
    max_batch_latency_ms: 10
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```

Priya (Product): Recommend conservative canary: 1% -> 5% over 4h with checks on p95, request_error_rate, and a small quality smoke test (10 golden confirmations + 20 explanations). Auto-rollback if p95 increases >18% or quality drop >2%. Well also include a token-usage probe for renewal impact.

Mina (SablePoint): 1%->5% fine. Security can sign off on vetted build within 48h if you provide checksums. Please avoid running canary during our nightly batch window at 01:30 CET.

Rafael (Solutions Eng): Canary payload (for config team):```json
{"canary":{"start_pct":1,"target_pct":5,"ramp_hours":4},"monitors":["p95","error_rate","quality_score"],"rollback":{"p95_increase_pct":18,"quality_drop_pct":2}}
```
Ill prepare a vetted q4 artifact (with identical tokenizer) and provide checksum. Playbook rollback: `redwood canary abort --id sablepoint-confirms`

infra-bot: Reminder: Private maintenance window eu-central at 2026127200. Rollouts will be paused during that window.

Noah (CSM): Action items: Rafael to build and checksum the q4 artifact; Priya to add golden prompts and quality probes; Mina to confirm compliance slot and share any tone checklist items. Ill schedule a 30-min enablement + security walk-through for Tue 09:00 CET.

Mina (SablePoint): Will share tone checklist + 10 golden confirmations by EOD. For renewal: if we hit ~15-25% p95 reduction at peak and ~12-18% token savings on confirms without quality regression, that materially helps expansion talks.

Priya (Product): Noted. Well add a short A/B probe inside the canary to track completion rate and token delta. Please keep any UX changes documented so we can include in renewal brief.

Rafael (Solutions Eng): Also note: if queueing persists due to reserved slots, we can recommend a short burst window for peak hours as a follow-up (cost tradeoff). Ill prepare cost delta numbers for the enablement.

Noah (CSM): Great. Capturing for records: goal = p95 -15% to -25% during peak, tokens per confirm -12% to -18%, no >2% quality regression. Will attach results to the renewal packet after canary completes. :white_check_mark:
